title: Control flow: @if
summary: Show or hide parts of a template with @if, @else if and @else.

quiz.q: Which template shows the paragraph only when `loggedIn` is true?
quiz.explain: The built-in control flow uses an `@if (condition) { ... }` block in the template.

quiz.q: Put the lines in order to build an if, else-if, else chain.
quiz.explain: Start with @if, then any number of @else if blocks, and finish with one @else. Each block's content sits between its braces.

quiz.q: With a signal `user = signal(null)`, how do you check it in the condition?
quiz.explain: A signal must be called to read it, so the condition is `user()`. The condition also needs parentheses.
`@else` follows the closing brace of the `@if` block.
